2610.12030.title: Natural Language to First-Order Logic LLM-based Autoformalization
2610.12030.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have renewed interest in autoformalization. Yet, when First-Order Logic (FOL) is considered as the target formalism, the field still lacks a unified task formulation and a systematic survey. This paper addresses this gap: we first provide a principled definition for the FOL-autoformalization task by distinguishing Ontology Extraction from Logical Translation, showing how their conflation obscures (cross-study) evaluation; we review existing datasets, evaluation metrics, and LLM-based methods, including fine-tuning, prompting, and verification-based refinement; we identify open challenges in benchmarking, semantic evaluation, ontology-aware methods, and end-to-end applications.
2610.12030.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）重新引起了對自動形式化的興趣。<lb/>然而，當考慮到一階邏輯（FOL）作為目標形式時，該領域仍然缺乏統一的任務定義和系統性的調查。<lb/>本文針對這一空白進行了探討：我們首先通過區分本體提取和邏輯翻譯，為FOL自動形式化任務提供了一個原則性的定義，顯示它們的混淆如何模糊（跨研究）評估；<lb/>我們回顧了現有的數據集、評估指標和基於LLM的方法，包括微調、提示和基於驗證的改進；<lb/>我們確定了在基準測試、語義評估、本體感知方法和端到端應用中的開放挑戰。
